description: `workspace.git.changes` answers the "edited N files +A −R" summary: every changed path of the working tree against HEAD with its added and removed line counts, its one-word status, and the totals. An untracked file is counted by its lines as git would show it once staged. A binary file, or a count that could not be read, carries no `added`/`removed` at all — never a zero standing in — and the totals cover only files whose counts are known. Three states like `workspace.git.status`: ok | not-a-repo | unavailable-with-reason.
